adaptations: Removed TypeScript annotations and module imports from selected pure functions.
selectRendered accepts already-rendered atomic protocol groups; tool-call/result groups are never split.
renderSkill receives resolved resource URIs from Java, with no filesystem discovery or shell access.
repeats reuses the upstream doom-loop predicate; DivZero additionally checks unchanged outcomes and context.
DivZero preserves operation IDs, UNKNOWN and unverified receipts outside generated summaries.
Only these pure functions run; no OpenCode agent, subagent, shell or permission-ask runtime is enabled.
